# Vellum

> International Style visual identity. Part of The Collective Style Guide Library.

Swiss grid, Helvetica-lineage type, single terracotta accent on cream paper. 2px radius, generous whitespace, calm motion. Built on IBM Carbon's accessible component foundation.

## Use this variant for

Documentation systems, knowledge bases, reading-heavy enterprise products, calm internal tools.

## Modes & densities

- Modes: `light`, `dark`
- Densities: `comfortable`, `compact`
- RTL: supported

## Quick token reference (light)

- Background: #F8F7F4 / Surface: #FFFFFF / Text: #1A1A1A / Border: #D6D3CC
- Accent: #B8442C (terracotta) — single accent
- Radius: 2px / Sans: neue-haas-grotesk-text

## Resources

- [Tokens (DTCG)](./tokens.json) / [Principles](./principles.md) / [Content](./content.md) / [Motion](./motion.md) / [i18n](./i18n.md) / [Starter prompt](./starter-prompt.md) / [Components](./components.json)

## Install

```ts
import { theme } from "@collective/vellum";
import { ThemeProvider } from "@collective/foundation";
<ThemeProvider theme={theme}><YourApp /></ThemeProvider>
```
